Use case: stylized-concept. Production game UI sprite for a polished Hearthstone-inspired fantasy tavern card board. Hand-painted chunky sculpted walnut timber, aged honey brass bevels, warm amber top-left light, deep occlusion, exquisite tactile craftsmanship, restrained teal gemstone accents. Actual transparent background, isolated object, front-facing almost orthographic, whole silhouette visible with tight margins. No lettering, no numbers, no symbols resembling text, no watermark. Asset: horizontal PLAYER WALLET plaque, roughly 2.3:1 wide. A small richly rendered open leather coin pouch with a few thick gold coins occupies ONLY leftmost quarter, integrated into the carved dark walnut plaque. Remaining right three quarters are clean very dark walnut inset for live readable UI text. Organic carved corners, brass fasteners, thick lower bevel. Compact and substantial, no legs or dangling decoration.
